concept: Moonstage greenhouse of signal and shelter
creativeDirection: A handcrafted paper-cut shadowbox collage combining pop screenprint, line drawing, miniature set design, and glossy resin objects.
scene: Inside a cavernous nighttime greenhouse viewed straight on like a theatrical stage, with a shallow reflective floor and glass roof fading into darkness.

elements.element: A giant suspended mask-like face reduced to its black sunglasses, pink lips, and yellow-green skin tones becomes the dominant moonlike presence overhead.
One glossy purple biomorphic form hangs as a floating resin fruit or lantern near the center-right.
One glossy pink biomorphic form hangs as a companion resin fruit or lantern near the center-left.
The embracing figures appear once as a thin black wire sculpture standing on the floor beneath the main focal area.
A green striped sphere becomes a large planet-like conservatory orb in the back, crossed by small bird silhouettes, with hints of retro interface framing worked into greenhouse ribs and floor lines.
A single vintage microphone on a tall stand occupies the foreground as the performance relic anchoring the scene, without depicting the woman.
A small wooden crate-like box at lower left contains a crouched red-haired woman in blue, as if part of the installation.
The floor transitions into meadow grass with shallow winding streams, interrupted by oversized keyboard keys used as stepping stones toward the microphone.

coverSummaries.album: Its Great When Youre Straight Yeah
coverSummaries.description: A tightly cropped pop-art portrait of a person’s face fills the frame. The skin is rendered in bright yellow-green, with dark hair, black sunglasses, and pink-purple lips. The sunglasses dominate the center, with white shapes filling both lenses. Bits of a reddish jacket and white collar appear at the bottom corners. The background is split between blue on the left and green on the right.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: black sunglasses on a brightly coloured face

coverSummaries.description: A minimalist cover with a single glossy abstract purple shape centered on a plain white background. The form is smooth, rounded, and biomorphic, with soft shading that gives it a plastic or liquid appearance. Small grey text sits below but the image is otherwise sparse.

A minimalist cover featuring a single glossy abstract pink shape centered on a plain white background. The shape is smooth, rounded, and biomorphic, closely matching the previous cover’s form, with subtle shading suggesting a plastic or liquid surface. Small pale text appears below.

A sparse white cover with a black continuous-line drawing of two human figures embracing near the upper center. The figures are simplified and faceless, outlined only by thin black lines, with arms wrapped around each other. Below the drawing is a line of stylized text.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: continuous-line drawing of two people hugging

coverSummaries.description: A retro-futuristic graphic design framed by a beige border. In the center is a large green striped oval or sphere against a dark charcoal background, with several black bird silhouettes flying across it. A pale circular moon or sun sits to the left. Beneath the sphere is a perspective grid floor, giving a synthetic landscape feel. Multiple bands and panels of interface-like graphics surround the main image.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: green striped sphere with bird silhouettes

coverSummaries.description: A photographic portrait of a woman with long dark hair against a softly lit pale background. She rests her face on one hand while holding a large vintage-style microphone toward the camera with the other, making the microphone prominent in the foreground. She wears a dark jacket and several rings, and her expression appears thoughtful or distant.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: vintage microphone held in front of a woman’s face

coverSummaries.description: A mostly white cover with a small square box centered slightly above the middle. Inside the box, a woman with long reddish hair crouches barefoot in a confined space, wearing blue clothing and bracing herself with her hands against the sides. A small blue object sits near her feet inside the box. Large wood-textured block shapes span the top margin.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: woman crouching inside a small box

coverSummaries.description: A landscape photograph of a grassy alpine meadow with winding streams in the foreground and mountains under a cloudy blue sky in the background. Across the middle of the scene are oversized computer keyboard keys arranged in staggered rows, appearing physically placed on the grass. A white rectangular label with rough black lettering floats near the top center.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: oversized keyboard keys placed across a mountain meadow

prompt: Inside a cavernous nighttime greenhouse viewed straight on like a theatrical stage, with a shallow reflective floor, glass roof fading into darkness, and a distant back wall dominated by a planet-like green striped orb crossed by tiny bird silhouettes; in the foreground center stands a tall vintage microphone on a slender stand, approached by oversized computer keyboard keys used as stepping stones across patches of meadow grass and winding shallow streams. Overhead hangs the primary subject: a giant mask-like pop-art face fragment, mainly black sunglasses suspended like a moon with yellow-green skin planes and pink-purple lips below, cropped and monumental rather than a full portrait. Add one glossy purple biomorphic resin lantern hanging center-right and one glossy pink biomorphic resin lantern hanging center-left; place a delicate black continuous-line wire sculpture of two people embracing beneath the microphone area; at lower left include a small wooden crate-like box containing a barefoot red-haired woman in blue crouched inside and bracing against the sides; subtly echo retro interface bands and grid perspective from the striped-orb source in the greenhouse ribs, edge framing, and floor geometry. Handcrafted paper-cut shadowbox collage with screenprinted color fields, miniature set design, thin wire sculpture, glossy poured-resin objects, and photographic texture fragments fused into one original mixed-media tableau. Strong central hierarchy with the sunglasses-face overhead and microphone below, supporting elements stepping inward from the edges, balanced negative space, and layered depth; soft moonlike backlight from the striped orb, dim spot illumination on the microphone and wire embrace, gentle reflections in the wet floor. Palette of acid yellow-green, charcoal, cream white, glossy purple, glossy pink, meadow green, sky blue, and wood brown; mood dreamlike, intimate, and slightly surreal. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
